name: Sequential vs batched CFG
plain: Whether cond and uncond are run in one batch or one after the other. Core decides this itself by memory, so no flag exists in stock KSampler: it fits as many as free memory allows. Video wrappers expose an explicit batched_cfg bool and default to sequential, saving memory for a slower step.
math:
Core: largest batch whose memory_required·1.5 < free_memory, otherwise trying len//2, len//3, … down to one item, per call.
WanVideoSampler: if not batched_cfg: run positive, then negative as separate transformer calls.

props.hook: None in core; sampler input in wrappers
